text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I saw tenant IDs from svc-a appear in logs for svc-b on the private cluster. Possible sidecar auth-proxy leak. :eyes:
raj: ugh, can you paste a snippet?
elaine: yep — redacted but you can see correlation headers crossed.
```
 2026-03-21T12:03:05Z svc-b sidecar auth: request id=abc123 tenant=tenant-svc-a path=/v1/infer
```
ben: where was this observed? host or central log aggregator?
elaine: central aggregator (priv ELK). The pod logs for svc-b show auth proxy header containing tenant-scope of svc-a.
sophie: did we change anything in the proxy RBAC or SA recently?
ben: we rolled PR #4217 last week that adjusted serviceAccount token audience and added a broader pod identity role for sidecars.
raj: that rings a bell — we loosened the proxy SA to read secrets from other namespaces during a KMS onboarding test.
elaine: possible vector: sidecar is pulling tenant-specific KMS envelope or creds and merging metadata. Might be KMS client adding tenant id to headers inadvertently.
sec-oncall: tagging for immediate TTP: @sec-oncall — please triage.
sec-oncall: on it. first step: can you dump the exact env + mount for the sidecar container in the affected pod? run `kubectl get pod svc-b-*** -n priv -o yaml` and `kubectl logs -c sidecar`
elaine: running now. also found a pattern: logs show shared /var/log socket read by sidecar.
```
# truncated
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root  234 Mar 21 11:59 auth-proxy.log
sidecar process reading /var/log/auth-proxy.log (mode: 0644)
```
raj: that sounds like a hostPath or shared emptyDir leakage. Which Helm chart mounted that?
elaine: chart `priv-sidecars` v2.3.1 — uses emptyDir for sidecar logs but we recently added a shared volume to help local dev replay.
sophie: ROOT CAUSE hypothesis: shared volume + broadened SA allowed sidecar to read other pod metadata and stamp tenant header. Not necessarily KMS bug but misconfig + RBAC.
ben: mitigation immediate: 1) disable sidecar injection for affected namespaces 2) remove shared volume from chart 3) rotate per-tenant KMS envelopes if any keys were referenced 4) tighten SA secret read scope.
sec-oncall: agreed. I'll trigger canary rollback for the `priv-sidecars` chart. @deploy-bot can you start the rollback?
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: chart priv-sidecars -> v2.3.0. ETA ~3m. :white_check_mark:
elaine: I've opened a ticket and pasted an example log and pod yaml in the ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/INC-4271 (internal)
raj: KMS rotation: are we able to rotate per-tenant envelopes without downtime? We should treat this as potential exfil of metadata only, but rotation is precautionary.
sophie: depends — if envelopes were used for auth tokens, rotate. If just metadata, rotate rotation-priority low but do audit first.
ben: also add a temporary audit filter rule: redact tenant headers before central indexing until we confirm. That avoids cross-tenant search leakage.
sec-oncall: action list I'm assigning: 1) @elaine: collect pod manifests + `kubectl cp` of sidecar container for binary inspection (due in 60m) 2) @raj: rollback chart PR + revert shared volume (30m) 3) @ben: open KMS rotation plan if keys referenced (120m) 4) @sophie: patch audit pipeline to redact tenant header (15m) 5) I'll run initial impact assessment and notify legal/compliance if PII risk (60m).
elaine: done — uploaded artifacts to INC-4271.
raj: reverted chart in dev and will push to staging in 10m.
ben: checking KMS logs now — searching for decrypt requests from the sidecar serviceAccount across namespaces: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.pod_id="svc-a-sidecar" AND protoPayload.serviceName="kms.googleapis.com"' --limit 50`
ben: no decrypt ops visible from that SA to other tenants, looks like metadata only.
sophie: I'm patching the audit pipeline now — adding a rule to drop headers matching `x-tenant-id` during indexing.
sec-oncall: good. once rollback finishes, do a quick smoke: ensure no tenant cross-refs in central index for last 24h. run queries with `tenant=*` to validate.
elaine: smoke done after rollback — no new cross-tenant lines appearing. older entries remain in ES index and need reindex/redaction.
ben: reindex plan: snapshot index -> run transform to remove tenant header -> restore snapshot to new index. I'll script this and run in maintenance window.
raj: long-term fixes: - remove shared volume from charts - enforce networkPolicy egress/ingress for sidecars only to KMS endpoints - tighten SA scopes - sidecar must not read pod filesystem outside its own container.
sophie: sample netpol snippet to start with:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: sidecar-restrict-egress
  namespace: priv
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: auth-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16  # KMS VPC
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
sec-oncall: also add admission webhook to prevent hostPath/emptyDir mounts shared across tenant namespaces.
elaine: raising PR for webhook and chart change now.
sec-oncall: incident classification: near miss, potential leakage of tenant metadata. notify customers? I recommend internal only for now unless evidence of PII exposure emerges.
ben: agreed. we'll finalize after reindex and key checks.
sophie: I'll add an automated test to our presubmit: fail chart if `sharedLogs: true` or hostPath present in sidecar template.
elaine: thanks all. will follow up in INC-4271 with timeline.
sec-oncall: leaving this thread open for updates. mark me or escalate if we find decrypt ops. :lock:
